_comment: Several products per domain (D4, best-answer plan 18 Nov 2026). Maps a catalog row's domain (its D1 key, e.g. a product host such as notebooklm.google.com) to a product URL /tools/<parent>/<slug>/. Empty until a product card is approved; the old /tools/<domain>/ path then 301s to the new one. See src/toolPaths.mjs.
